bio.text: Jamie Ager is a Democratic candidate for North Carolina's 11th Congressional District in 2026.
According to his campaign, he was born in Fairview and raised on his family's Hickory Nut Gap Farm, and describes himself as a fourth-generation farmer.
His campaign says he graduated from A.C. Reynolds High School and Warren Wilson College, and that he and his wife Amy built Hickory Nut Gap, a sustainable meat company.

sources.title: Fairview Farmer Jamie Ager Announces Campaign for Congress in North Carolina's 11th Congressional District
National Dems back Ager in NC-11 Democratic primary
